title: Two Toddlers Playing with Stroller Indoors, 1962 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing two toddlers in a mid-century American living room in early 1962. One child stands in striped overalls looking off to the side, while the second child stands behind a small wire-basket stroller or doll buggy, clutching the handle grips. The background reveals typical early 1960s suburban home furnishings, including low-profile armchairs, a television set, and a carpeted floor. The scalloped edges of the photo print are characteristic of late 1950s and early 1960s home photo processing.
